title: GLM-Z1-9B-0414 generation loops after roughly 100 tokens
body: I am running llama.cpp build 5121 (c94085df) on Linux with CUDA and an RTX 3080. When I start llama-server with THUDM_GLM-Z1-9B-0414-Q5_K_M.gguf, generation begins normally but loops after roughly 100 tokens. The same problem appears with Q8_0 and also when I use --jinja. Transformers with 4-bit loading produces a completely cogent response on the same model.

symptoms_visible: GLM-Z1-9B-0414 starts generating but falls into repetitive output after roughly 100 tokens in llama-server.
The behavior occurs with Q5_K_M and Q8_0 and still occurs when I use --jinja; the Transformers 4-bit run produces a cogent response.
N0.label: N0 GLM-Z1 generation loop reported

symptoms_visible: The generated response still becomes repetitive in llama.cpp even though the F16, Q8_0, and Q5_K_M perplexity results are close to one another.
N1.label: N1 quantization degradation checked

symptoms_visible: With glm4.rope.dimension_count set to 64 and tokenizer.ggml.eos_token_id set to 151336, the model produces coherent output instead of the original repetition.
N2.label: N2 metadata override probe succeeds

symptoms_visible: After rebuilding with the candidate changes and quantizing the model again, GLM-Z1-9B produces coherent output without the original generation loop.
N3.label: N3 candidate converter changes verified

symptoms_visible: A newly converted and quantized GLM-Z1-9B-0414 model now generates coherent responses without falling into the roughly 100-token repetition loop.
N_terminal.label: terminal resolved

question_patterns: Do you have perplexity results that compare the full-precision and quantized models?
Can you check whether the quantized files have substantially worse perplexity than F16?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I calculated perplexity on 50 chunks of my calibration data. F16 is 29.9842 +/- 1.09088, Q8_0 is 30.0564 +/- 1.09404, and Q5_K_M is 30.2513 +/- 1.09810.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: My Q5 and Q8 perplexity values are dramatically worse than F16, and only the quantized files produce repetitive output.
The exact values differ slightly on another calibration sample, but F16, Q8_0, and Q5_K_M remain very close.

edges.comment: Reporter c3 supplied these raw perplexity values after the opening report. They show the measured relationship among the quants but do not themselves identify the conversion defect.

question_patterns: Can you try the proposed command-line metadata overrides and report how the generated output changes?
Please rerun the same prompt with the suggested metadata values and tell me whether the repetition remains.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: With --override-kv glm4.rope.dimension_count=int:64 and --override-kv tokenizer.ggml.eos_token_id=int:151336, the output improves and the Q8_0 model works correctly instead of entering the original loop.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The output still enters exactly the same repetition loop with both metadata overrides.
The model is coherent with the two overrides, although sampling makes the wording different from my Transformers response.

edges.comment: Affected-user reports c7-c9 are folded into the simulated user side. This is a handler-initiated configuration probe: the answer reports the exact command values and observed output, while the conclusion that the converter mishandled GLM-0414 metadata remains engineer-side.

question_patterns: Can you test the candidate branch with a newly produced model file and report whether the loop remains?
Please build the candidate changes, create fresh quants from the source model, and test the same prompt.
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I can confirm the candidate changes fix the issues. I rebuilt and made fixed quants, and the model now works, so I am reuploading those quants.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: A newly produced and quantized model from the candidate branch still loops after roughly 100 tokens.

edges.comment: Participant1 c19 and the original reporter c20 tested the candidate converter work; the reporter explicitly confirmed that it fixed the reported issues and reuploaded corrected quants. This is pre-landing verification, so it is modeled as a measurement rather than the final solution.

solution.intent: Fix GLM-4-0414 conversion so the GGUF records the model's half-RoPE dimension and correct EOS token metadata, use the GLM4 template as the default, then reconvert and requantize the model rather than treating the problem as quantization damage or a template-only issue.
solution.concrete_example: Update the GLM-0414 conversion path to turn partial_rotary_factor=0.5 into glm4.rope.dimension_count=64, select token 151336 as EOS when processing the model's multiple EOS tokens, and provide the GLM4 template by default. Reconvert the Hugging Face model and rebuild the GGUF quants; existing files can be tested temporarily with the equivalent metadata overrides.
solution.inference_hint: The users reported raw perplexity values, the successful dimension/EOS override test, and the successful candidate-branch model test. Mapping those observations to the converter's missing partial_rotary_factor handling and multiple-EOS handling is the engineer's diagnosis. Later reports about FP16 accumulator overflow on Volta, ROCm, Metal, and Vulkan describe a separate hardware/backend problem and must not replace the root cause of the reporter's original RTX 3080 conversion issue.

edges.comment: The opening reporter confirmed the converter changes fixed the original looping issue in c20 and reuploaded corrected quants in c24. The later /props crash and backend-specific FP16/Vulkan failures are independent sub-problems from other deployments and are deliberately excluded from this diagnostic chain.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the original GLM-Z1-9B-0414 failure as bad conversion metadata: the converter failed to apply the model's partial rotary factor, yielding the wrong RoPE dimension, and did not correctly handle the model's multiple EOS tokens.

Must ground the diagnosis in the collected evidence: similar F16/Q8/Q5 perplexity, cogent Transformers output, improvement with RoPE dimension 64 and EOS token 151336 overrides, and successful generation after rebuilding and producing fresh quants with the candidate changes.
Must recommend fixing the GLM-0414 conversion path and producing new GGUF quants; command-line metadata overrides may be presented as a temporary test or workaround.
Must not claim that --jinja or selecting the GLM4 chat template alone resolves the reported generation loop, since template changes alone were tried while endless repetition remained.
Must keep the later Volta, ROCm, Metal, and Vulkan numerical-precision reports separate from the reporter's original RTX 3080 conversion issue.
Must have an affected user verify a newly produced model containing the converter changes before declaring the original issue resolved.

persona_hint.experience_level: Technically capable llama.cpp user who can build the project, run llama-server, compare quantizations, calculate perplexity, test converter branches, and publish corrected GGUF files, while deferring low-level numerical and backend analysis to maintainers.
persona_hint.communication_style: Concise, collaborative, and evidence-driven; provides exact commands and measurements, quickly tests proposed fixes, and openly notes uncertainty outside their expertise.
